# Painomed

> Buy pain relief, anxiety and sleep medicines online in the USA. No prescription required. Fast, discreet delivery from Painomed — your trusted online pharmacy.

Painomed is an online pharmacy serving customers across the United States. We offer pain relief medicines, anxiety medicines, sleep aids, wellness products and everyday healthcare essentials with no prescription required for eligible products, secure checkout (including Bitcoin), and fast, discreet delivery.
